basic_profile.bio: Born and raised in Cork, I have an undeniable love for my city and its vibrant culture. By day, I work as a graphic designer for a local agency, and by night, I dive into the world of gaming and sci-fi. My girlfriend recently moved in with me, and we love exploring the local pubs and scenic spots together. I'm mostly online during the evenings and weekends. Traveling is a passion, but nothing beats the comfort of home. I'm not a fan of negativity and prefer spaces that encourage positive and constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design from the Cork Institute of Technology, which has been the foundation for my career. My love for sci-fi shows, particularly 'Doctor Who', has led me to become well-versed in pop culture and entertainment trivia. I also stay updated on gaming trends through streams and community discussions.
